minimalRecommendation: Fix the deterministic classification boundary for SKILL, FINANCIAL_GOAL and CAREER_EDUCATION using information already present; do not collect more user data for those six cases.
Define and editorially approve the INITIAL runtime-state contract, separating known goal facts from mission-produced facts.
Ensure a safe bootstrap mission path exists from INITIAL state for common goals; do not make approval-dependent missions the only otherwise viable candidates.
Treat Parent approval, people, permissions and money rules as mission-specific gates and request them just in time.
Map existing autonomy_level only after confirming semantics, and never make it a global gate.
